proposed_fixes.title: Preserve locale-specific key identities when Keyboard Manager reloads mappings
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Keyboard Manager appears to serialize or deserialize the Spanish-layout brace key through the US-layout slash identity, leaving the saved mapping operational but no longer editable.
plan: Trace key identity serialization and display-name reconstruction for the shared slash and brace physical key across keyboard layouts.
Persist an unambiguous virtual-key and scan-code representation and validate it before loading the editor model.
Add migration or recovery handling so one malformed entry does not block all edits.
verification: On US and Spanish Latin American layouts, map the affected punctuation keys, restart the editor, and verify that mappings remain correctly identified, editable, and removable.

confidence.rationale: The corruption is deterministic and includes the affected layouts and key pair, but the exact serialization field causing the alias requires code confirmation.
